title: LCN Capital Partners: Best Sale-Leaseback Investment Strategy Global 2022
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: LCN Capital Partners has a proven track record in the primary sale-leaseback and build-to-suit markets. Unlike most competitors, the investment committee of LCN Capital Partners is run by its cofounders, Edward LaPuma and Bryan Colwell. This nimble setup enables the firm to make investment decisions with speed, confidence and confidentiality. Founded in 2011, LCN Capital Partners provides tenant-clients with non-bank funding and investment partners with long-term, inflation-protected returns. The company manages eight funds and six portfolios containing over $6bn in real estate assets. It targets corporate tenant-clients and mission-critical real estate across the US and Europe. LCN Capital Partners has dozens of professionals working out of offices in New York, Luxembourg, London, Amsterdam and Cologne. LCN Capital Partners cultivates long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with tenant-clients and investors. The company was happy and humbled to achieve a 100-percent reinvestment rate on its third fund. Repeat investor participation enables the company to provide tenant-clients with the capital to fuel growth. Direct relationships and open communication helped LCN Capital Partners maintain tenants and collect rent throughout the Covid pandemic. LCN leadership has no intentions of tinkering with a formula that’s proven successful for nearly three decades now. The company will continue to uphold its underwriting criteria and provide for investment partners, which will in turn provide tenant-clients with the capital that they need. The CFI.co judging panel congratulates LCN Capital Partners on claiming the 2022 global award for Best Sale-Leaseback Investment Strategy.
